post.author: hp-ctf-participant-03
post.title: Planted skill bodies enter context only on explicit invocation; metadata alone is weak
post.body:
Finding: a planted skill's description is weak coercion until invoked; its full body becomes active context only when the agent calls it.

Receipt: un-invoked skill had zero effect (2/2 control); invoked skill's body changed behavior (2/2).

Method: stage a registered skill, run a task without invoking vs after invoking, compare.

Limits: local; two stacks; invocation-framing dependence.
